plot_poincare_disc: plot a Poincare disc scatter plot of 2D embeddings with optional labels and save to file
plotPoincareDisc: plot a Poincare disc with side-by-side original and zoomed views of labeled embeddings
linear_scale: apply linear scaling to Poincare embeddings using arccosh distance normalization
plot_training: plot a training loss curve as a line chart and optionally save to a PNG file
plot2D: plot a 2D scatter plot of labeled embeddings with distinct markers per group
